title: getQueryData
subtitle: Get current data for a query
description: Synchronously get the current cached data for a query without triggering a fetch or subscription.

rows.name: queryKey
rows.description: Unique identifier for the query. Can be a string or array of primitives.

rows.name: options
rows.description: Optional configuration object. If no fetcher is provided, uses a previously registered fetcher.

returns.description: The current cached data for the query, or undefined if not cached

examples.title: Basic Usage
Conditional Logic
examples.description: Use cached data for conditional operations

behavior.title: Synchronous
behavior.description: Returns data immediately without waiting for network requests

behavior.title: Cache Only
behavior.description: Only returns data that's already in the cache

behavior.title: No Side Effects
behavior.description: Does not trigger fetches or subscriptions

behavior.title: Type Safe
behavior.description: Returns properly typed data or undefined

dos: Use for conditional logic based on cached data
Use in event handlers and non-React code
donts: Don't use in render functions (use useQuery instead)
Don't assume data will always be available
Don't use for data that must be fresh
Don't forget to handle undefined cases

callouts.title: Cache Access
callouts.content: getQueryData only returns data that's already cached. It won't trigger a fetch if the data doesn't exist.
